ratingBifurcationExplanation.headlineFinding: While MoveInSync's India storefront displays a 4.64★ lifetime rating (4.32★ in the US storefront), this headline figure is heavily masked by 91,256 rating-only taps without review text and 1,407 1–2 word micro-reviews ('good', 'nice', avg 4.64★, 46.9% of newest reviews) generated by mandatory post-ride rating prompts. Among users who write substantive reviews (>=6 words, n=1,066), the average rating drops to 2.71★ (54.5% 1–2★); among detailed reviews (>=15 words, n=483), the average rating collapses to 2.19★ (67.1% 1–2★); and Google Play's default 'Most Relevant' storefront view (n=600) averages 2.11★ (67.7% 1–2★, 77.7% 1–3★).

developerResponseAudit.auditFinding: MoveInSync has not replied to a single public Google Play review since February 2, 2026 (>8 months of silence). Furthermore, 55 reviews in the corpus (33 of which are now 1–3★ dissatisfied reviews, including 29 1–2★) show users who previously received a generic 'Thank you very much for your review!!!' reply in 2021–2024 subsequently editing their rating down in 2025–2026 without follow-up.

dataCompletenessAndLimitations.newestWindowCoverage: 100% of publicly accessible English reviews posted between 2025-09-22 and 2026-10-11 (n=3,000).
limitations: Public Play Store reviews represent ~14.1% (3,333 / 23,625) of lifetime written reviews and ~2.9% of total star ratings (114,881); findings apply to the verified 2025–2026 written-review cohort and default storefront view, not silent tap-only raters.
9.7% of newest reviews (291 / 3,000) omit `reviewCreatedVersion` metadata when posted via web browser or older Play Store clients.

Historical storefront aggregate rating snapshots prior to October 13, 2026 do not exist publicly; temporal trends are measured strictly from verified review timestamps (`at`), not fabricated historical storefront scores.
User-reported symptoms do not include stack traces or server logs; technical root-cause mechanisms require internal validation against Crashlytics and API telemetry.

dimensions.name: Prevalence & Storefront Visibility
dimensions.definition: Combines total theme mentions across all star ratings (35%), community thumbs-up 👍 endorsement (40%), and presence in Google Play's default Most Relevant stream (25%).

dimensions.name: Severity & Journey Criticality
dimensions.definition: Combines commuter critical-path blocking impact (55%), 1-star rating concentration (25%), and mean rating deficit below 3.0★ (20%).

dimensions.name: Temporal Velocity (H2 Surge)
dimensions.definition: Measures issue acceleration between H1 (Oct 2025–Mar 2026) and H2 (Apr 2026–Sep 2026) (65%) plus acute complaint density in the last 60 days across v12.17.0–v12.19.0 (35%).

dimensions.name: Confidence & Software Attributability
dimensions.definition: Measures how cleanly the evidence isolates an application-layer software defect owned by MoveInSync engineering vs. external vendor/employer policy confounders (70%) plus validated classifier F1 accuracy (30%).

dimensions.name: Engineering Feasibility (Inverse Effort)
dimensions.definition: Scores how rapidly MoveInSync's mobile and backend teams can ship and verify a deterministic fix (1–2 sprints = high feasibility) without renegotiating third-party fleet contracts.

prioritizationMethodology.whyMostFrequentIsNotRankedFirst: Fleet Operations (`CAB_ROUTING_DISPATCH_OPS`) has the highest raw count of negative reviews (429 reviews, 36.4% of negative corpus), followed by Scheduling/Roster (`BOOKING_ROSTER_SYNC`, 235 reviews) and Live Tracking (`LIVE_TRACKING_MAP_ETA`, 230 reviews). However, ranking purely by raw mention count would misdirect mobile engineering toward physical cab delays, driver conduct, and employer cost-clubbing policies (`C = 3.5`, `F = 3.5`), which MoveInSync's mobile app cannot solve in code. By weighting Software Attributability (23%), Severity (22%), and Temporal Velocity (20%), the model ranks `ISS-01: Live Tracking, Map Zoom & ETA` #1 (86.46/100), `ISS-03: Blocking Modals & Forced Rating` #2 (85.16/100), and `ISS-02: Launch Crashes & Play Store Block` #3 (80.80/100), while placing confounded Fleet Operations #5 (74.17/100).

issuesRegister.title: Live Vehicle Tracking Freeze, Map Auto-Zoom Reset & ETA Divergence
issuesRegister.plainLanguageSummary: Commuters waiting for assigned cabs experience frozen vehicle pins on the route map, automatic map camera zoom-outs every 3 to 30 seconds that undo manual pinch-zooming, wildly inaccurate ETAs (e.g., jumping from 3 mins to 20 mins or diverging 3x from Google Maps), a v12.19.0 restriction blocking live tracking >60 minutes before trip time, and total loss of trip/OTP details when opening the app in low-signal basements or metro stations.

reportedSymptomVsRootCause.reportedUserSymptom: Map zooms out automatically every few seconds while tracking; cab icon stays stuck while driver is already at pickup; ETA shows 20 mins when cab is outside (or 15 mins when it takes 60 mins); opening app in basement loses ride details and boarding OTP.
reportedSymptomVsRootCause.technicalRootCauseHypothesis: 1) MapView camera bounds listener (`LatLngBounds` including pickup + vehicle + office destination) is re-triggered on every GPS websocket/polling tick (every 5-30s) without checking if the user has manually panned/zoomed (`isUserGesture`). 2) Driver GPS telemetry lacks dead-reckoning/staleness indicators when driver Partner Lite app is background-throttled. 3) Active trip card and boarding/drop OTP are fetched synchronously on cold start without a local Room/SQLite offline cache.

issuesRegister.title: Critical-Path Modal Friction: Seatbelt Blocking OTP, Forced Rating & Policy Pop-ups
issuesRegister.plainLanguageSummary: Recent UI updates (v12.18.x-v12.19.0) introduced blocking modal dialogs right on the boarding critical path: (1) clicking 'View OTP' triggers a mandatory seatbelt safety pop-up that hides the boarding OTP; (2) opening the app forces a prior-ride rating dialog with no 'Skip' option, directly provoking angry users to leave 1-star reviews on Google Play; (3) Terms/Policy acceptance prompts appear repeatedly on every button click or launch; and (4) un-closable delay pop-ups block access to the emergency SOS button while push notifications arrive late or repeat endlessly.

reportedSymptomVsRootCause.reportedUserSymptom: Seatbelt check hides OTP when boarding; cannot use app without rating previous ride (no skip button); policy acceptance pops up on every button click; notification pop-ups cannot be closed and block SOS button; false 'trip not booked' push alerts sent even after booking.
reportedSymptomVsRootCause.technicalRootCauseHypothesis: 1) Seatbelt compliance prompt is bound to the OTP reveal action rather than post-boarding trip-start state. 2) Post-ride feedback modal sets `isCancelable(false)` with no dismiss CTA. 3) Policy consent boolean flag is not persisted cleanly in local user profile state. 4) In-app alert dialog queue stacks multiple delay modals above the main scaffold (obscuring the SOS button).

issuesRegister.title: App Launch Crashes, Post-Update State Corruption & False Play Store Integrity Block
issuesRegister.plainLanguageSummary: Following recent updates (v12.17.0 to v12.19.0), users experience immediate cold-start crashes, indefinite blank/splash screens (especially on Android 16/17, Pixel 8, OnePlus 12, Vivo), or a false blocking security dialog stating 'MoveInSync application cannot be opened as it was not downloaded from Play Store' every 2-3 days, forcing employees to repeatedly uninstall and reinstall the app.

reportedSymptomVsRootCause.reportedUserSymptom: App closes immediately upon opening; freezes on blank white/black screen after update; displays fake 'not installed/downloaded from Play Store' error despite official Play Store installation; requires uninstalling and reinstalling every 2-3 days to work.
reportedSymptomVsRootCause.technicalRootCauseHypothesis: 1) Custom installer-package verification (`PackageManager.getInstallSourceInfo` / Play Integrity check) misidentifies background Play Store auto-updates, Android 16/17 package installer sessions, or OEM/work-profile containers as sideloaded APKs. 2) Unhandled schema migration or corrupted WebView/SharedPreferences state across rapid v12.17->v12.18->v12.19 updates causes fatal startup exception until app data is wiped via reinstall.

issuesRegister.title: Commute Scheduling, Roster Sync, Silent Evening Auto-Cancel & Night-Shift UX
issuesRegister.plainLanguageSummary: Employees face scheduling and roster synchronization failures: (1) being marked 'No-Show' on a morning login trip silently cancels the evening logout trip without any warning notification; (2) ad-hoc bookings place medically vulnerable or regular employees on a waitlist without clear waitlist confirmation; (3) night-shift schedules display 'Logout and Login' under the same calendar date in a confusing order that causes accidental missed bookings; (4) workplace seat/desk allocations disappear after booking; and (5) Metro QR tickets lack offline caching and force 100% screen brightness that fails on certain station scanners.

reportedSymptomVsRootCause.reportedUserSymptom: Evening logout trip cancelled automatically without reminder after morning No-Show; app shows no slots while web portal allows booking; books onto waitlist without informing user; night-shift Logout/Login date order is confusing; desk number disappears from workplace booking; Metro ticket has no offline QR and forces max brightness.
reportedSymptomVsRootCause.technicalRootCauseHypothesis: 1) Backend 'Consecutive/Linked No-Show' rule cancels paired return trips silently without firing a push/SMS confirmation prompt. 2) Roster calendar UI groups shifts by UTC/midnight boundary rather than shift-workday grouping, confusing overnight shifts. 3) Mobile slot availability cache lags web portal state.

issuesRegister.plainLanguageSummary: The largest raw volume of negative reviews complains about physical commute execution: (1) routing algorithms clubbing passengers from opposite directions or different states into a single cab, turning a 20-minute commute into a 1.5-2 hour journey; (2) cabs not being assigned on time or arriving 1 hour late (or 1 hour too early); and (3) unprofessional, rude, or rash driver behavior and unannounced driver cancellations.

reportedSymptomVsRootCause.technicalRootCauseHypothesis: 1) Enterprise employer transport admins configure aggressive vehicle-occupancy/clubbing parameters to reduce per-seat transport cost, trading off detour time. 2) Third-party fleet vendor shortages and urban traffic cause dispatch delays. 3) App lacks transparent in-app route-detour feedback and driver-behavior escalation tracking, causing employees to blame the MoveInSync app on Google Play for vendor/employer operational failures.

risksAndGuardrails: Guardrail 1 (Stale Cached OTP Risk): If a cab is dynamically re-assigned while the user is offline in a basement, displaying an outdated cached cab number could cause confusion. Mitigation: Display 'Cached at HH:MM — Reconnect to verify live cab changes' banner when offline >10 minutes.
Guardrail 2 (Battery & Memory Impact): Keeping local Room cache and map listeners active must not increase Android Vitals ANR rate (>0.47% threshold) or foreground battery drain (>2% per commute).

Guardrail 3 (No Causal Overclaim): Storefront lifetime rating (4.64★ IN / 4.32★ US) is an inertia-heavy cumulative average of 114,881 ratings; impact must be measured on version-tagged monthly cohort metrics rather than claiming immediate lifetime rating movement.

decisionConditions.continueAndScale: If `LIVE_TRACKING_MAP_ETA` negative share drops by >=40% relative to baseline on `v >= 12.21.0` with zero regression in crash/ANR rate after 30 days.
decisionConditions.modifyIntervention: If map-zoom complaints stop but ETA inaccuracy complaints persist (>8% share), escalate from client smoothing to backend routing ETA calibration + Partner Lite background GPS wake-lock audit.
decisionConditions.reverseOrRollback: Immediate staged-rollout halt if cold-start crash rate increases by >0.2% or if cached OTPs cause >0.5% boarding mismatch tickets.

monthlyMonitoring.deduplicationGuarantee: Each monthly run ingests reviews into `movesync_intelligence.db` keyed by primary `reviewId` (Google Play UUID) and secondary `dedupHash` (SHA-256 of normalized text + YYYY-MM-DD + star rating). Reviews already recorded in prior months are never double-counted as new reviews unless their `at` timestamp advances due to a user edit (`isEditedAfterReply`).
